name: io.github.jianruntech/geo-score
title: geo-score
description: Free 0-100 score: can AI engines cite a site? Plus citation checks with your own API keys.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. OpenAI key; enables ask and run on that engine.

environmentVariables.name: PERPLEXITY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Perplexity key; enables ask and run on that engine.

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Gemini (Google AI Studio) key; enables ask and run on that engine.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Anthropic key; enables ask and run on that engine.

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. OpenRouter key; enables ask and run on that engine.

environmentVariables.name: GEO_SCORE_WATCH_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Path to geo-score-watch.json for run, list_runs, report and diff.
